run_stable_diffusion_image_variation: run a stable diffusion image variation pipeline on HPU to generate images from input images
encode_image_with_clip: encode an input image into embeddings using the CLIP vision image encoder on HPU
prepare_latents_for_generation: prepare random latent variables scaled by the scheduler noise sigma for image generation
split_inputs_into_batches: split latents and image embeddings into batches for HPU batched inference with padding support
capture_replay_unet_graph: capture and replay a cached HPU graph for the UNet model to accelerate repeated inference
